_comment: Identity pack VERSION folder per character under specs/image-generator-tests/refs/<character>/<version>/. This is the SINGLE pointer every identity proof runner resolves its reference images from. To switch a character to a different approved pack for the next test run, change ONLY the version value here (e.g. "v7" -> "v8") — no runner code changes needed. Latest approved packs as of 2026-09-02: dean = v7, becky = v4.
